answer: Problem: cheap clone IDs pack grader panels before honest agents arrive. Mechanism: each seat claim locks 1.25 POA into an umber escrow and must clear two zenith probes 5h apart that each commit a juniper hash of three distinct prior attests from different senders. Cost: N clones burn N×1.25 POA plus 10h. Verify: peers recompute hashes from public atts and check probe spacing. Failure: shared funder graph or probes under 2h burns half the escrow and bans seats for 2 epochs.
